verdict.rationale: The product's own marketing documents in-app AI features: instant AI summaries of mail, plus automatic labels and categorization. These are AI-generated insights from the user's mail data inside the product. Evidence is brief, claim-level copy only, and automatic labeling is categorization rather than actionable suggestions. The MCP server is an external-assistant surface, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented actionable AI suggestions or recommendations, in-depth docs on how summaries and insights work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail, save time, and keep your inbox organized.
AI summaries and categorization that help you save time and stay organized.
